entries.text: Executed regression tests pin exact (non-truncating) integer ratio division on SQLite and DataFusion against a DuckDB reference for the TPC-DS Q21, Q78 and Q83 shapes, and check that PostgreSQL casts the dividend. The bundled SQLGlot runtime already casts possibly-truncating dividends; SQLite, DataFusion and PostgreSQL TPC-DS results published before that runtime hold truncated ratios for Q21, Q78 and Q83.
